description: This file is a minified JavaScript library (vis.js) for browser-based dynamic visualizations. It includes functionality for network graphs, data handling, and visualization utilities. The content suggests it is a compiled or minified version of the library, providing core visualization features for a web UI project.

classes.name: Edge
classes.description: Represents a visual edge in a network graph, with methods for rendering, positioning, and interaction handling.

classes.name: Node
classes.description: Represents a node in a network graph, including properties for position, size, and visual appearance.

classes.name: PhysicsEngine
classes.description: Manages the physics simulation for node positioning and movement, including force calculations and stabilization.

classes.name: Cluster
classes.description: Handles grouping of nodes into clusters for visualization purposes, with methods for creating, expanding, and collapsing clusters.

classes.name: CanvasRenderer
classes.description: Responsible for rendering nodes, edges, and other visual elements onto an HTML canvas.
